cases.expected: Header.toWire(out) is invoked once; no Record.toWire is invoked because the only non‑null section contains an empty list.

cases.expected: Header.toWire(out) is invoked once; iteration encounters a null Record in a non‑empty section and throws NullPointerException, propagating the exception.

group: Message.toWire(DNSOutput) - order of header and records

group: Message.toWire(DNSOutput) - separate Compression instances per call

cases.description: Verifies that the method does not retain a static or cached Compression object across separate invocations, which could corrupt name compression state.
